limits: Observed source totals are not whole-company totals.
AP/AR roles and final-state stocks are retrospective proxies; not verified allocations.
Due-face includes terminal cancellations: documented issuance, not enforceable complete costs.
Cash has two cutoff scenarios, unknown completeness/restrictions, no stock FX and no independent reconciliation.
Receipt growth is not sales; classification, currency and account perimeter may change.
No model, labels, predictive validation or six-question success claim.
meta.provenance_grain: company_id/month in marts; product_id/anchor_source_row for balances; issued/due invoice aggregate query in queries.json

score_policy.components: Pure dimension_points reused for generation/growth/stability only. S=mean six observed receipts; F=receipts minus due AP face proxy. No cash-payment cost reduction.
score_policy.interval_scope: Operating document/receipt scope only, NOT global health or a confidence interval. True company full interval remains [0,100] because unobserved perimeter is unbounded.
score_policy.mora_penalty: 40*E/(S+E); unknown E implies [0,40]. Missing dimensions imply [0,100], fixed weights, no renormalization. Publish interval only, never midpoint.
score_policy.nonpayment: With fixed receipts and issued due obligations, reduced bank payment cannot increase any component. Provisional mora can only lower the scoped score; missing mora gives uncertainty, not zero.

snapshot_context.reason: debt_products lacks measured date; extraction context only, signed raw outstanding, not historical or verified debt
